item: A failed backup signature is never shown as Not signed
summary: New merges store origin_fingerprint 'bad-signature' when a signature was present but did not match (a new value; earlier rows untouched, R755). A stored 'unsigned', which cannot tell the two apart, reads 'No verified signature' (x12); 'Not signed' stays where the live state is known (verify, restore report), which now also say 'bad-signature'. The custody chain id files both non-key states under unknown-origin, so a failed signature is never grouped with genuine signers.
